name: Shelby County, AL
findings: Shelby County has 801 nonprofit organizations. 303 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 250 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Shelby County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 76 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Foundation organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 foundation organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do foundation organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
